name: BoardWorkspace - RoundHeldOpen
description: Typing holds the round open. The steps here are the real path and the reason this is an interaction scenario rather than a prop fixture: amending an answer on a board with nothing left open arms the countdown, and then a single keystroke in the chat cancels it — the row goes back to 'Everything on the board is answered · Next round' and stays there. That cancel is the promise the countdown is allowed to exist on, because the seconds after finishing are exactly when the remark that fits on no card arrives; automation that took that moment away would be a thing done TO the person. Deterministic to capture, unlike the countdown mid-flight: once held, it does not restart, so the frame is the same however long the capture settles.

interactions.value: Owner call-backs, and always the ones promised late in the shift.
One more thing before we hand it back
